messages:
jess: Quick thread 0000000000000000000000 jess: We have a new quota banner that appears when a project hits its monthly token quota. PM wants it firm but not alarming. Current: "Quota reached. Contact billing." Feels terse. Also a11y: screen readers don't announce the banner reliably. Figma: https://figma.redwood/quota-banner (frame) li: +1 on tone concerns. Options: - Friendly: "Youve reached your monthly quota. Upgrade or pause features to continue uninterrupted." - Direct: "Monthly quota reached. API calls are paused. Upgrade to resume." - Minimal: "Quota reached. Actions paused." Which should be primary? :thinking_face: drew: From support volume, people react badly to the word "paused" without context. Suggest we explain consequence and next step in one line. Something like: "Youve hit your monthly token limit. API requests are blocked until you upgrade or wait for reset (in X days)." Keep the CTA button text to "Upgrade" and a secondary link "See quota details". kate: Accessibility notes: - Use role="status" and aria-live="polite" so SRs hear the message when it appears but its not too disruptive. - Ensure the banner is keyboard-focusable and that focus isn't stolen from active tasks. If a modal opens after clicking upgrade, move focus into the modal. - Contrast: banner background must meet AA for body text and CTA. copy-bot: Quick microcopy A/B candidates (short/long): A (helpful): "Youve reached your monthly token limit. API requests are currently blocked. Upgrade to continue or wait until your quota resets in X days." B (concise): "Monthly quota reached — API requests blocked. Upgrade to resume." C (soft): "Looks like youre out of tokens for the month. Upgrade to keep calls flowing." jess: I like A for the banner body, B for compact mobile. CTA primary: "Upgrade plan" (more explicit than "Upgrade"). Secondary link: "View quota details". We should avoid scary words like "blocked"? Drew disagrees. li: Re: "blocked" it's clear but maybe too blunt. "temporarily paused" is softer. Test copy with support team. drew: Support says clarity reduces tickets. They prefer "blocked" so users immediately know the impact. Let's compromise: body uses "blocked" but the helper paragraph explains reset/next steps. kate: Implementation note for devs: set aria-live on the banner container and add visually-hidden prefix for SRs: "Billing notice:" so its categorized. Example: ```
Billing notice:

You've reached your monthly token limit. API requests are temporarily blocked. Upgrade plan

``` jess: Good. Also request translations: avoid idioms and keep sentences short. Localizers: body should be <= 120 chars ideally. li: I'll draft a small ticket with final copy and link to Figma. Acceptance criteria: - Banner copy matches approved variant A/B per platform - role=status + aria-live=polite present - CTA and secondary link visible and meet contrast - Mobile uses compact copy B - Translation review done copy-bot: Ticket #4412 created with selected copy A (desktop) and B (mobile). Figma frame id: figma://frame/quota-banner/7. jess: Thanks. One last tiny UX nit: animation for banner entrance should be reduced motion-aware (prefers-reduced-motion). Add that to the ticket. li: Noted and added. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
